title: Stores at the crossing

branches.condition: Troop transport arrives without passage protection
branches.consequence: Delivered Transport Troops without funded Protect the Passage or an effective Warrant adds Stability −1. This also applies when civilian relief arrives in the same round.

branches.condition: The Narrows are repaired and Wayfarer completes its commercial contract
branches.consequence: Funded Repair the Narrows and a completed private Wayfarer contract add Stability +1. Routine maintenance does not qualify.
Neither extra Stability effect occurs. Resolve all other effects normally.

public_rules: Repair adds 2 to prepared Beacon, capped at 4, before voyages. Both conditions can occur: Grey Petrel may carry troops while Lantern repairs and Wayfarer trades. Protection removes the stores loss without removing the distribution benefit.
